summary: Leon Sparks (44) fell off-route into 5th-class terrain near 14,000 ft on El Diente Peak when a hold broke, shattering his ankle; he summoned help via Garmin inReach and Mesa Verde Helitack flew him to an ambulance.
location: El Diente Peak, San Juan Mountains
notes: ANAC 2023 edition (Pub 2023); incident date Jul 31 per article.
wx_note: ERA5 archive 0.25° grid (Open-Meteo); coord basis: peak (El Diente Peak)
